---
name: "✨ Feature Request"
about: "Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new capability within the Jarvis product scope."
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

## 🎯 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature and why it is valuable.

## 💡 Motivation & Problem Solved
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g. "I want Jarvis to be able to ... without having to ...")

## 🏗️ Proposed Architecture & Solution
Describe how this feature should work conceptually:
- Which layer does it touch? (`CoreBrain`, `ToolNexus`, `SovereignMemory`, `OmniPresence`)
- Is it a standalone tool plugin under `backend/plugins/`?
- What is the confirmation gate risk level? (`auto`, `confirm_once`, `confirm_always`)

## 🚫 Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, libraries, or workarounds you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context & Mockups
Add any mockups, screenshots, or API documentation links here.
